title: Jump-1
description: A 2d6 space-trading roguelite. Crew a 200-ton ship bought on credit, trade across the Lantern Reach, and stay ahead of the bank's repossession cruiser. English by default, with French available.
controls: Mouse or touch: choose actions, worlds and cargo.
Arrow keys: move map cursor. Enter or Space: confirm. Escape: back.
1-5: crew stations. L: log. M: map. S: ship. R: standard week. Q: quick stop.
Solo campaign. The room capability is reserved for the cooperative edition.
credits: Cédric Bernadac - design, original setting, publication.
Developed with Codex and Kimi K3.1. Original Blender art by Kimi under the direction of Cédric Bernadac.
